relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright, tangy flavors of preserved lemon complement the smoky heat of Harissa, making them a great combination for a balanced dish.

relations.name: Berbere
relations.rationale: Berbere is another North African spice blend that shares similar warm spices with Harissa, and can be used to enhance the flavor profile of various dishes.

relations.name: Ras el Hanout
relations.rationale: Ras el Hanout features a complex mix of spices that can be used alongside Harissa to deepen the flavor in Tunisian recipes.

relations.name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
relations.rationale: The richness of the beef and the variety of vegetables can be elevated with the addition of Harissa, adding depth and spice to the dish.
